summary_md: **Nathan Lambert ([@natolambert](https://x.com/natolambert/status/2115428494515777629))** publishes a meta-review of the benchmarking industry around Artificial Analysis v5, arguing open models' demise is exaggerated but the old index flattered them, and calling for more task-specific intelligence indices.
